title: Frontend: Markdown Editor
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Markdown Editor. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Controlled Markdown textarea previews a safe limited grammar: each line starting # becomes h1, ## becomes h2, all other lines become p. Strip the marker plus one optional following space. Render all remaining characters literally, not HTML. Wrap preview in [data-testid="preview"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep raw Markdown as the editing source and debounce expensive parsing only when measurements justify it.
alternativeApproaches: Add asynchronous preview computation with revision checks so stale parses cannot overwrite newer text.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Raw HTML; script-like links; code fences.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
